text:
Maya (Partnerships): Heads-up: joint workshop with StratusWorks next Thu 2pm PT. Format: 75min hybrid, 3 segments (marketplace live-deploy, SI connector demo, edge inference). Need final ops checklist + speaker confirmations.
Chris (Events): Proposed run: 5m intro, 20m marketplace, 20m SI, 15m edge + 15m Q&A. AV ask: 2 camera angles, HDMI ingest, stage mic + presenter lapel. Is that OK?
Devon (Field): StratusWorks will bring 1 rack unit (x1 dev board + router). They request 2x power strips, 1x HDMI, and a static DHCP reservation. Also: customs docs if we cross regions.
Priya (Product): Marketplace demo will show 1-click deploy -> demo tenant creation -> inference endpoint smoke test. Need an on-stage operator to click and validate. Who volunteers?
Maya (Partnerships): I can do the on-stage click. Please give me a test org and a deploy token. Also request StratusWorks 2-sentence partner quote and a speaker bio by Tuesday.
Rae (Ops): Shipping timeline: if loaner ships Wed AM, it arrives Thu 08:00. We need HS code + pro forma invoice and serial numbers by Mon COB. label created once we get docs.
Devon (Field): Noted. I'll collect HS codes and serials and upload to the shared drive: https://drive.example/stratus-shipping.
Chris (Events): Streaming details: encoder machine will capture HDMI + a browser tab. Please make sure the demo machine can mirror its HDMI output to the encoder. If not, we'll use a capture box.
Priya (Product): SI connector demo plan: 10m architecture + 10m live connect (we'll use a replay webhook to avoid exposing prod creds). Need someone to trigger the webhook.
Maya (Partnerships): @Devon can you own webhook creds and make the replay URL available for rehearsal?
Devon (Field): Yep. I'll hand over a replay URL and a sandbox API key. I'll DM the key.
Rae (Ops): ship-bot: label prepped -> https://tracking.example/FEDEX/SWPKG9988. ETA Thu 08:12. Customs form uploaded. :truck:
ship-bot: Package SWPKG9988 logged, pro forma pending, ETA Thu 08:12 local.
Chris (Events): Rehearsal: Wed 09:30-10:30 PT. Must attend: all presenters + stream operator. We'll run through handoffs and the failover script.
Priya (Product): Failover plan: if StratusWorks hardware is unavailable, switch to recorded session + local VM serving the same model. We'll announce to audience that it's a recorded fallback.
Maya (Partnerships): Post-event assets: can someone own the co-blog + marketplace listing updates? Timeline: draft within 48h, partner review 48h, publish within 7 days.
Priya (Product): I'll draft the technical asset (how-to + config snippets). Need StratusWorks logo files and a short quote.
Devon (Field): StratusWorks asked for customs note template. I'll attach the template in the drive and cc their logistics contact.
Rae (Ops): Ops note: mark shipments as "temporary import - demo equipment" and include serial numbers on the pro forma or customs will hold it. Also add estimated return date.
Maya (Partnerships): Final checklist I will post later today: run order, speaker minute-by-minute, AV shots, rehearsal link. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
Chris (Events): Copy. See you at rehearsal. :wave:
